# Lakshya Mock & Marks Tracker

> Ultra-lightweight self-hosted mock test score tracker and performance analytics engine for Indian competitive exams (RRB JE, WBPSC, SSC CGL, Banking, GATE).

## Core Capabilities
- Automated negative marking calculations (-0.33, -0.50, -0.66, custom)
- 12 major Indian languages + English i18n support
- Part-wise weak point and strong point visual radar/bar analytics
- Mistake diary with category breakdown (silly error, concept gap, time pressure)
- 1-Click universal bookmarklet & clipboard screenshot OCR
- Kanboard Project #4 sync and offline manual exam management
- SQLite database persistence with zero cloud dependencies

## API Endpoints
- [Web Dashboard](/): Interactive analytics dashboard
- [Health Check](/api/health): Application heartbeat & timestamp
- [Exam List](/api/exams): Active pursued exams & syllabus configurations
- [Mock History](/api/mocks): Historical mock tests, sectional scores & mistakes
- [Aggregated Stats](/api/stats): Trend scores, subject strengths & weak areas
- [JSON Backup](/api/export): Complete database export & backup
